title: Attribution
description: Which session created a resource, with the evidence `muretto why` shows.

resource_id.description: Stable Muretto resource id: <kind>:<provider_id>. Deterministic, so two machines that see the same resource produce the same id.

label.description: exact needs stored evidence. There is no 'likely' label: Muretto never shows a guess.

session_id.description: Set only when label is exact.

rule_id.description: The attribution rule that fired, e.g. id_in_result or name_in_container.

reason.description: Plain-language reason, e.g. 'no recorded agent session created it' or 'two sessions created a table with this name'.

evidence.description: Non-empty when label is exact. For unknown, may list conflicting evidence.

action_id.description: The Claude Code tool_use_id of the action.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session id (a UUID).

excerpt.description: Redacted text excerpt. Never contains secrets: redacted at record time and again at output.
